title: An Old Book, a New Plan
kicker: GPT 独立第 1 组 · 第 3 篇
how: 同一批骨架和词，第三个场景。读完不要立刻重读：先说出美为什么买旧书、怎样赶到学校，再试着把自己的经历填进骨架。点黄色词可听有道发音。

paras.en: On Friday afternoon, Mei went to a used-book fair near her office. She was [[in a hurry]]: she needed to [[pick up]] her little brother from school at four. [[To find a gift]] [[within]] her [[budget]], she looked at used books. A new book cost more than she could [[afford]].
paras.cn: 周五下午，美去了办公室附近的旧书市集。她赶时间，因为四点要去学校接弟弟。为了在预算内找到礼物，她翻看旧书；新书太贵，她买不起。

paras.en: She [[came across]] an old book about local parks. It was [[almost]] [[as useful as]] the new one, and much cheaper. The seller [[recommended]] a park by the river. Mei [[spotted]] a photo of a small [[picnic]] area in the book. She [[decided]] to go there with her brother on Sunday. She [[made sure]] the book was in her bag.
paras.cn: 她偶然发现一本介绍本地公园的旧书。它几乎和新书一样有用，却便宜得多。摊主推荐了河边的一座公园，美在书里看到了那里的小型野餐区。她决定周日带弟弟去，还确认书已经放进包里。

paras.en: Outside, the [[wind]] blew hard. Mei [[held]] her bag close. A [[crowd]] waited at the bus stop, but the school was only two [[blocks]] away. She walked past them and arrived [[in time]]; her brother was [[already]] waiting.
paras.cn: 外面风很大。美把包紧紧抱在身边。公交站有一群人在等车，不过学校只有两个街区远。她从人群旁走过去，及时赶到了；弟弟已经在等她。

paras.en: At home, they made a list for Sunday: [[groceries]], [[snacks]], and a [[blanket]]. "We can [[wrap]] our sandwiches before we leave," Mei said. Her brother smiled. "Then we won't be [[in a hurry]] in the morning." They planned to leave early and enjoy their day together.
paras.cn: 回到家，他们列了周日的清单：食材、零食和野餐毯。美说：「我们可以出门前把三明治包好。」弟弟笑着说：「那早上就不用手忙脚乱了。」他们计划早点出发，一起好好度过那一天。

focus.core: 美翻旧书是为了找到预算内的礼物，和第 1 篇为了省钱做饭不同。
forms: To find a gift within her budget, she looked at used books.
To help her, Noah picked up two bags.（第 2 篇）
focus.warn: 目的短语的动作执行者通常就是后面主句的主语：找礼物和翻书的都是美。

focus.core: 旧书几乎和新书一样有用；almost 表示差一点达到同样程度。
forms: It was almost as useful as the new one.
The path was not as busy as the main road.（第 2 篇）
focus.warn: almost as useful as = 几乎一样有用；不是完全相等。

focus.mean: 偶然遇到 / 发现、看见
focus.core: 无意间翻到旧书；之后在书里看见公园的照片。
forms: She came across an old book.
Mei spotted a photo in the book.
focus.warn: come across 强调意外碰上；spot 强调眼睛发现。

focus.core: 开始着急接人，后来及时赶到学校；次日准备好就不用慌。
forms: We won't be in a hurry in the morning.
focus.warn: in time to meet her brother = 来得及接弟弟；on time 强调按约定时刻准点。

focus.core: 这里是去学校接弟弟，不同于第 2 篇从店里取货。
forms: She needed to pick up her brother from school.
Noah picked up two bags at the shop.（第 2 篇）
focus.warn: 宾语是代词：pick him up；不是 pick up him。

drills.cn: 为了在预算内找礼物，她翻看旧书。
drills.en: [[To find a gift within her budget]], she looked at used books.

drills.cn: 这本旧书几乎和新书一样有用。
drills.en: It was almost [[as useful as]] the new one.

drills.cn: 她偶然发现一本介绍本地公园的旧书。
drills.en: She [[came across]] an old book about local parks.

drills.cn: 她四点得去学校接弟弟。
drills.en: She needed to [[pick up]] her little brother from school at four.
She arrived [[in time]] to pick up her brother.

drills.en: We can [[wrap]] our sandwiches before we leave.

speak.q: 说一件你为了省钱或赶时间而做过的事。
speak.a: To save money, I looked at used books.

speak.q: 比较两件你用过的东西，说明它们是否一样好用。
speak.a: My old bag is almost as useful as my new one.

speak.q: 说你偶然碰到什么，然后做了什么决定。
speak.a: I came across an old book, so I decided to read it.
